research_note: Published Nov 9, 2026. Counts span public GitHub observations through Nov 7, 2026. Valid means valid at detection, not necessarily currently active.

segments.title: AI CODING SECRET LEAKS
segments.caption: AI coding tools can expose credentials.
segments.speech: Code Crew! What if your AI coding assistant accidentally leaked your secret API keys?

segments.title: 31,088 SECRETS
segments.caption: GitGuardian research, published November 9.
segments.speech: Security researchers at GitGuardian found over thirty-one thousand distinct secrets in Claude Code settings files on public GitHub!

segments.title: 5,343 VALID
segments.caption: Valid when detected, not necessarily today.
segments.speech: And here's the scary part: more than five thousand of those credentials were still valid when researchers detected them!

segments.title: HOW DID THIS HAPPEN?
segments.caption: Illustrative example, not actual product footage.
segments.speech: When a developer permanently approves a command containing a secret, Claude Code can save that whole command in a local settings file. If that file gets committed, the secret can leak!

segments.title: PROTECT YOUR KEYS
segments.caption: Rotate exposed credentials. Review and scan.
segments.speech: The fix? Keep secrets out of commands and commits, scan repositories, and rotate any exposed keys. AI helps you code faster, but security still needs your attention! Follow Learn With Obscure for your next tech update!
